subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing the build-artifacts runtime tar step with this contract-owned pack-and-smoke script for the dist-runtime-build artifact?
rationale: The patch is technically supported and proven, but it intentionally makes the CI artifact producer stricter and adds runtime smoke failure modes to build-artifacts, which is a maintainer-owned automation tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the stricter artifact producer
options.body: Land after exact-head or merge-queue proof, keeping the manifest guard and extracted runtime smoke as the CI contract for this artifact.

options.title: Split or narrow the smoke gate
options.body: Ask for the pack step and the expensive runtime smoke to be separated if build-artifacts latency or flake risk is not acceptable in this job.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the linked packaging issue open and defer the artifact contract until the CI owner decides the producer shape.

recommendation.title: Accept the stricter artifact producer
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head or merge-queue proof, keeping the manifest guard and extracted runtime smoke as the CI contract for this artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee, authored the maintainer repair commit on this PR branch, and already documented the artifact proof and remaining automation-risk tradeoff.
